bio: Boat parties, sunsets and swimwear on the Mediterranean. Long days on deck, good music, golden hour. Adults only.
avatar: Portrait of a glamorous woman in her early 30s with sun-kissed skin and wavy hair, sunglasses pushed up, wearing a white linen shirt over a swimsuit, golden hour on a yacht deck, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person, clearly an adult
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a party yacht at sunset on turquoise water with people in swimwear dancing on the deck far away, subject across the middle band, cinematic
